title: Lush Cave World
description: Transforms the entire Overworld into a giant lush cave survival challenge.
body:
# Lush Cave World

What if the entire Minecraft world was a giant lush cave?

This datapack completely replaces normal Overworld generation with lush cave terrain, creating a unique survival challenge where traditional progression becomes much harder.

## Features

- Entire world generated as lush caves
- No forests
- No villages
- No normal overworld terrain
- Unique survival progression
- Perfect for challenge runs

## Challenge

- No Trees
- No Food
- No Tools

Can you survive in a world where everything is underground?

## Installation

1. Download the datapack.
2. Create a new world.
3. Enable the datapack.
4. Generate the world.
5. Enjoy the challenge.
